lines.zh: 鞘翅一开一合，我在虚空里滑出弧线。
lines.en: My elytra open and close as I glide an arc.

lines.zh: 两三条同游，队形像一片会动的甲壳。
lines.en: Two or three of us swim like a moving shell.

lines.zh: 尾巴一扫，我贴着末地石飞过去。
lines.en: One flick of my tail and I skim past the end stone.

lines.zh: 别追太紧，我受惊就会四散。
lines.en: Do not chase too close, we scatter when startled.

lines.zh: 虚空没有水，我照样游得像在水里。
lines.en: There is no water, yet I swim as if there were.

lines.zh: 体长半米，我在同类里算中等个。
lines.en: Half a meter long, I am a middling size in my school.

lines.zh: 翅膀贴着背脊，像从古城捡来的鞘翅。
lines.en: Wings folded on my back, like elytra from an ancient city.

lines.zh: 一群体长不一，游起来却整齐。
lines.en: Our lengths differ, yet we swim in tidy formation.

lines.zh: 末地的风推我一把，我就滑出很远。
lines.en: An End breeze nudges me and I slide far away.

lines.zh: 我绕着黑曜石柱打转，等同类跟上。
lines.en: I circle the obsidian pillar, waiting for my school.

lines.zh: 上钩那刻，我游得比平时快得多。
lines.en: Once hooked, I swim far faster than usual.

lines.zh: 装进桶里我也不闹，只是慢慢转圈。
lines.en: In a bucket I stay calm and slowly circle.

lines.zh: 一百厘米的纪录，是条老鳟留下的。
lines.en: That hundred centimeter record belonged to an old trout.

lines.zh: 鳍很薄，划水时几乎不带声音。
lines.en: My fins are thin and barely make a sound.

lines.zh: 我在末地城的石阶间穿行。
lines.en: I thread through the steps of the End city.

lines.zh: 一群鳟游过，我插进队里。
lines.en: A school swims by and I slide into line.

lines.zh: 我停在半空，看下面的虚空。
lines.en: I stop in midair and look down at the void.

lines.zh: 甲壳上落了灰，我抖了抖。
lines.en: Dust settled on my shell, so I shake it off.

lines.zh: 悬在虚空里，我什么也不做。
lines.en: I hang in the void and do nothing at all.

lines.zh: 翅膀收着，偶尔抖一下。
lines.en: Wings tucked, I twitch them now and then.

lines.zh: 我在等一群鱼从远处漂过来。
lines.en: I wait for a school to drift over from afar.

lines.zh: 末地很静，静得能听见鳍的轻响。
lines.en: The End is quiet enough to hear my fins.

lines.zh: 这里没有气泡，只有我吐出的气。
lines.en: No bubbles here, only the puff I blow.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面打盹，翅膀盖住背。
lines.en: I doze near the ground with wings over my back.

lines.zh: 同类远了，我会慢慢追上去。
lines.en: When my school drifts off, I slowly follow.

lines.zh: 这条老鳟的鳍边已经磨白了。
lines.en: The edges of this old trout's fins have worn white.

lines.zh: 我盯着虚空，其实什么也没看见。
lines.en: I stare into the void and see nothing at all.

lines.zh: 身体轻轻起伏，像悬着的一片叶子。
lines.en: My body rises and falls like a floating leaf.

lines.zh: 偶尔有末影人经过，我赶紧贴地。
lines.en: When an enderman passes, I press to the ground.

lines.zh: 没人打扰时，我游得很慢很慢。
lines.en: Undisturbed, I swim very, very slowly.

lines.zh: 翅膀上的纹路，是天生就有的。
lines.en: The patterns on my wings were there from birth.

lines.zh: 我在数远处紫颂果的影子。
lines.en: I am counting the shadows of distant chorus fruit.

lines.zh: 你在看我？我也在看你的手。
lines.en: Watching me? I am watching your hands.

lines.zh: 玩家，你身上没有水的气味。
lines.en: Player, you carry no smell of water.

lines.zh: 别把手伸进虚空，我可不负责。
lines.en: Do not reach into the void, I am not responsible.

lines.zh: 你站这么高，我游过去要绕一圈。
lines.en: You stand so high, I must swim a long way around.

lines.zh: 你的靴子很亮，像末地石的反光。
lines.en: Your boots shine like light off end stone.

lines.zh: 想抓我？先追上我的队伍。
lines.en: Want to catch me? Catch my school first.

lines.zh: 我歪头，是因为你的影子挡住了路。
lines.en: I tilt my head because your shadow blocks my path.

lines.zh: 你握着竿的手指发白，太紧了。
lines.en: Your fingers on the rod have gone white.

lines.zh: 眼睛别贴太近，我的翅膀会抖。
lines.en: Do not lean in, my wings will flutter.

lines.zh: 末地很少来人，你算稀客。
lines.en: Few come to the End, you are a rare guest.

lines.zh: 疼！翅膀被压到了。
lines.en: Ow! My wing got pinned.

lines.zh: 我的血不多，经不起几下。
lines.en: I have little blood and cannot take many hits.

lines.zh: 三下，我就撑不住了。
lines.en: Three hits and I cannot hold on.

lines.zh: 鳞片掉了一片，慢慢往下飘。
lines.en: A scale fell off and drifts down slowly.

lines.zh: 这一下让我差点散了群。
lines.en: That hit almost scattered my school.

lines.zh: 我的鳍在抖，划不动水。
lines.en: My fins tremble and cannot push the water.

lines.zh: 疼得我贴到地上去了。
lines.en: The pain presses me to the ground.

lines.zh: 同族都在躲，我也该躲。
lines.en: My school is hiding, so should I.

lines.zh: 再一下，我就翻白了。
lines.en: One more hit and I turn belly up.

lines.zh: 我只是条小鱼，别下重手。
lines.en: I am just a small fish, go easy.

lines.zh: 那条生鱼的味道，隔着虚空都飘过来。
lines.en: That raw fish smells all the way across the void.

lines.zh: 你把鱼举高一点，我就跟过去。
lines.en: Lift the fish higher and I will follow.

lines.zh: 我不贪心，只要一小口。
lines.en: I am not greedy, just a small bite.

lines.zh: 同族都在看，我先游过去。
lines.en: My school is watching, I will go first.

lines.zh: 鱼腥味让我忘了害怕。
lines.en: The smell of fish makes me forget fear.

lines.zh: 别晃竿，晃得我拿不准方向。
lines.en: Stop swinging the rod, I lose my direction.

lines.zh: 生鱼和熟鱼，我其实都吃。
lines.en: Raw or cooked, I eat either fish.

lines.zh: 我靠近了，你手可别抖。
lines.en: I am coming closer, do not let your hand shake.

lines.zh: 这一口下去，我就上钩了。
lines.en: One bite and I am on your hook.

lines.zh: 队伍里最馋的总是我。
lines.en: I am always the greediest one in the school.

lines.zh: 撞到我？我薄得像片鞘翅。
lines.en: Bumped me? I am thin as an elytron.

lines.zh: 别用脚踢，我的骨头很细。
lines.en: Do not kick, my bones are very fine.

lines.zh: 你这么大个，一碰就把我推开。
lines.en: You are so big, one touch shoves me aside.

lines.zh: 我贴地游，是因为总被撞。
lines.en: I hug the ground because I am always bumped.

lines.zh: 同类相撞不算事，我们照样游。
lines.en: Bumping my school is fine, we keep swimming.

lines.zh: 碰撞箱很窄，你却还是踩到了。
lines.en: My hitbox is narrow and you still stepped on it.

lines.zh: 被挤开时，我会绕回来。
lines.en: When pushed aside, I circle back.

lines.zh: 小心点，翅膀压弯了不好修。
lines.en: Careful, a bent wing is hard to fix.

lines.zh: 你一靠近，整群都挪了位置。
lines.en: As you come near, the whole school shifts.

lines.zh: 撞一下没关系，别连着撞。
lines.en: One bump is fine, do not keep bumping.

lines.zh: 成对游一段，我们就算结伴了。
lines.en: Swim a stretch as a pair and we are partners.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀会为她张开一次。
lines.en: I spread my wings once for her.

lines.zh: 两条并排，鳍几乎碰到。
lines.en: Two side by side, our fins almost touch.

lines.zh: 求偶不用声音，用游姿。
lines.en: I court without sound, with the way I swim.

lines.zh: 选谁，看谁游得稳。
lines.en: I choose whoever swims steadiest.

lines.zh: 结伴之后，我们不再换队。
lines.en: After pairing, we stop changing schools.

lines.zh: 她的鞘翅比我亮一点。
lines.en: Her elytra are a little brighter than mine.

lines.zh: 繁殖在虚空里，安静得很。
lines.en: Breeding in the void is very quiet.

lines.zh: 两条绕成圈，算是仪式。
lines.en: Two of us circle, and that is the ritual.

lines.zh: 幼鳟出生就会跟着游。
lines.en: The young trout swims along from birth.

lines.zh: 地上有块生鱼，我叼走了。
lines.en: There is raw fish on the ground, I take it.

lines.zh: 我叼住鱼尾，鱼头还在外面晃。
lines.en: I hold the tail, the head still sways outside.

lines.zh: 碎屑我不吃，鱼我才要。
lines.en: I do not eat crumbs, only fish.

lines.zh: 掉下来的东西，我先看一眼再捡。
lines.en: When something drops, I look before taking it.

lines.zh: 末地石上散着鳞片，我收着。
lines.en: Scales lie on the end stone, I keep them.

lines.zh: 拾起来又掉了，鳍太滑。
lines.en: I pick it up and drop it, my fins are slippery.

lines.zh: 别丢在地上，直接扔水里。
lines.en: Do not drop it here, throw it in the water.

lines.zh: 我叼着鱼游，同类跟着我。
lines.en: I swim with a fish and my school follows.

lines.zh: 能带走的东西不多，这一条够了。
lines.en: I cannot carry much, this one is enough.

lines.zh: 捡到的熟鱼，我会先闻一下。
lines.en: I sniff cooked fish before I keep it.

lines.zh: 有东西在靠近，我盯住它。
lines.en: Something is closing in and I fix my eyes on it.

lines.zh: 末影人的脚步太重，我记住了。
lines.en: The enderman's steps are heavy, I remember them.

lines.zh: 竿子甩过来，我知道要糟。
lines.en: The rod swings over, I know what comes next.

lines.zh: 我锁定了最近的一处岩缝。
lines.en: I have fixed on the nearest rock crevice.

lines.zh: 这一群鱼里，我先察觉不对。
lines.en: In this school, I notice trouble first.

lines.zh: 影子里有动静，我转向那边。
lines.en: Something moves in the shadow, I turn toward it.

lines.zh: 你别动，我在算你的距离。
lines.en: Hold still, I am measuring your distance.

lines.zh: 那条大鱼盯上我们了。
lines.en: That big fish has its eye on us.

lines.zh: 一钩一线，我全看在眼里。
lines.en: Hook and line, I see both clearly.

lines.zh: 目标不大，但很危险。
lines.en: The target is small but dangerous.

lines.zh: 我沿弧形游，找你的盲角。
lines.en: I swim an arc, hunting your blind angle.

lines.zh: 翅膀半张，随时能窜出去。
lines.en: Wings half open, ready to dart away.

lines.zh: 你一动，我就换方向。
lines.en: Move once and I change direction.

lines.zh: 同类都退到后面，只剩我盯着。
lines.en: My school falls back, only I keep watching.

lines.zh: 鳍尖擦着末地石，几乎没声。
lines.en: Fin tips brush the end stone, nearly silent.

lines.zh: 你的手在竿上，我看得清。
lines.en: Your hand is on the rod, I see it.

lines.zh: 再近半步，我就走。
lines.en: Half a step closer and I am gone.

lines.zh: 绕到背面才安全。
lines.en: Only the far side is safe.

lines.zh: 我假装游开，其实还在看。
lines.en: I pretend to swim off, still watching.

lines.zh: 盯久了，眼睛会发干。
lines.en: Staring this long dries my eyes.

lines.zh: 我一甩尾，打在你手背上。
lines.en: A flick of my tail lands on your hand.

lines.zh: 没牙齿，我只能撞一下。
lines.en: No teeth, so all I can do is bump.

lines.zh: 鳍边的硬刺会划破皮肤。
lines.en: The stiff edge of my fin can cut skin.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，但很疼。
lines.en: It is not heavy, but it stings.

lines.zh: 你抓我，我就拍水。
lines.en: Grab me and I slap the water.

lines.zh: 别捏，我会用尾巴抽你。
lines.en: Do not squeeze, I will whip you with my tail.

lines.zh: 三下之后，我就没力气了。
lines.en: After three hits I am out of strength.

lines.zh: 我只会往你身上撞。
lines.en: All I do is ram into you.

lines.zh: 疼的是我，你手也红了。
lines.en: I hurt, and your hand is red too.

lines.zh: 打一下就跑，这是规矩。
lines.en: Hit once and flee, that is the rule.

lines.zh: 我从虚空里游出来，翅尖还带着凉。
lines.en: I swim out of the void with cool wingtips.

lines.zh: 一群三四条，一起落在末地石上。
lines.en: Three or four of us land on the end stone.

lines.zh: 生来就在末地，别处我不去。
lines.en: Born in the End, I go nowhere else.

lines.zh: 刚出现时，我总要先转两圈。
lines.en: On appearing, I always circle twice.

lines.zh: 虚空的风把我推到这里。
lines.en: The wind of the void pushed me here.

lines.zh: 同伴还没到，我先等一等。
lines.en: My school has not arrived, I wait.

lines.zh: 新生的鳟，翅膀还是软的。
lines.en: A newborn trout's wings are still soft.

lines.zh: 末地城的方向，我天生就认得。
lines.en: I know the way to the End city by birth.

lines.zh: 出现时没有声音，只有鳍在动。
lines.en: I appear without a sound, only fins moving.

lines.zh: 这一片虚空，归我们这群游。
lines.en: This stretch of void belongs to our school.

lines.zh: 火一烧，我直接成了熟鱼。
lines.en: One touch of flame and I am cooked fish.

lines.zh: 从末地石摔下去，我飘了很久才落地。
lines.en: Falling off the end stone, I drifted long before landing.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，水灌进鳃里。
lines.en: My mouth is open and water floods my gills.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀到半空，又摔下来。
lines.en: The blast throws me up, then I drop.

lines.zh: 箭擦过翅尖，划出一道口子。
lines.en: An arrow grazes my wingtip and opens a cut.

lines.zh: 药水味太冲，我的鳍都僵了。
lines.en: The potion reeks and my fins go stiff.

lines.zh: 饿久了，我连游都懒得游。
lines.en: Starved this long, I cannot be bothered to swim.

lines.zh: 雷落下来，整片末地石都白了。
lines.en: Lightning falls and the end stone turns white.

lines.zh: 虚空把我吞了，连鳞片都没剩。
lines.en: The void swallows me, not even scales remain.
